recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Pork Tenderloin, Potatoes & Brussels
ing: 2.5 lbs pork tenderloin (one piece is for Friday — see step 6)
2 tbsp olive oil · 4 cloves garlic, minced
2 tsp smoked paprika · 1 tsp garlic powder · 1.5 tsp salt · pepper

steps.t: Oven to 425°F. Pull the pork out now — 20 min at room temperature cooks far more evenly than straight from the fridge.
Toss potatoes cut-side down with 1 tbsp oil and a third of the spice. Roast 15 min alone.
Pat both tenderloins dry, rub with the remaining oil, garlic, and spice. Dry surface or no crust — this is the whole game.
Pull the pan, push potatoes aside, add both tenderloins and the sprouts cut-side down. Back in for 18–20 min.
Pull at 145°F. Pork tenderloin goes from juicy to chalky in about 4 minutes — use a thermometer, not the clock. Rest 8 min before slicing.
Slice one tenderloin into 3 dinners with the potatoes and sprouts. Shred the second one and container it separately — that is Friday.
Boil the eggs now while the oven is still hot and you are already standing here.

recipes.note: Two tenderloins, two jobs. Sliced medallions for the plated dinners, shredded for Friday’s bowl — shredded pork holds sauce better and does not go rubbery cold.

recipes.name: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry
ing: 1.5 lbs chicken breast, sliced thin against the grain
Sauce: 3 tbsp soy sauce · 1 tbsp honey · 2 tsp sesame oil · grated ginger · 2 cloves garlic

steps.t: Mix the sauce in a mug first. Once the pan is hot there is no time to measure.
Screaming-hot pan, thin film of oil. Chicken in one layer — do not stir for 2 min or it steams instead of browning. Then toss until cooked, ~6 min total.
Onion and broccoli in with a splash of water. Cover, 3 min — the steam cooks the broccoli through while the pan stays hot.
Sauce in. Let it bubble and tighten around everything, about 1 min.
Microwave both rice pouches.
Three containers: rice base, stir-fry on top. Scallions when you eat, not now.

recipes.note: Slice the chicken while it is half-frozen. Twenty minutes in the freezer and you can cut it thin enough that it cooks in six minutes instead of twelve.

steps.t: Medium-high, splash of oil. Onion and pepper, 4 min.
Add turkey. Break it up, cook until no pink, ~7 min.
Taco seasoning + 1/3 cup water. Simmer 3 min until it thickens.
Squeeze in half a lime and stir. Off the heat.
Microwave both rice pouches.
Three containers: rice base, turkey on top. Keep the yogurt out.

extra.label: Add when you eat
items: 2 tbsp Greek yogurt — your sour cream, same texture, 3g protein instead of 0

recipes.name: Crispy Pork Carnitas Bowl
ing: 1 oz cheese · 2 tbsp salsa · 2 tbsp Greek yogurt · lime

steps.t: Hot dry skillet, pork spread in one layer. Leave it alone for 3 minutes. The shredded edges crisp into actual carnitas — this is the whole reason to shred it Monday rather than slice it.
Toss once, another minute, then off the heat. Squeeze half a lime over it in the pan.
Rice pouch in the microwave while the pork crisps.
Rice down, pork on top, then cheese, salsa, and yogurt.

recipes.note: Reheated pork is usually the sad part of a meal plan. Crisping it in a dry pan instead of microwaving it is the difference — browned edges instead of steamed leftovers, for about ninety seconds of extra effort.
